content.title:
Exam week at home:
*how to help.*
content.subtitle: IIM B UGAT is on 15 Nov. Small things at home make a big difference.

qa.q: Should I ask about mock scores?
qa.a: Ask what they learned from the mock, not the score. The score this week matters less than fixing mistakes.

qa.q: How much study is too much?
qa.a: In the last week, sleep matters as much as study. A tired mind makes silly mistakes in the exam.
Check the admit card and test centre a day early, plan the route, and keep the morning calm.
qa.note: Always follow the official instructions on the admit card.
